title: 7 Examples of Small Business Using Video to Build Their Brand

facts.fact: Vidyard's featured case study quotes customer Superside saying personalized Vidyard video messages drove an 8x improvement in click-through rates and a 4x improvement in reply rates (a vendor-showcased customer claim, not independently verified).
facts.value: 8x click-through rate improvement; 4x reply rate improvement
facts.quote: “Personalized Vidyard video messages drove an 8x improvement in click-through rates and a 4x improvement in reply rates.”
